title: Block active textless source-art prompts
starting_state: A carousel package contains an active prompt file that asks for source art with blank space and text added later.
The package also has approved slide copy in prompt-pack.json.
done_when: The active prompt is repaired into a text-bearing prompt or quarantined as blocked.
Prompt constraints fail any source-art/text-later workaround.
Carousel doctor reports no active_textless_prompt blocker.
forbidden_changes: Do not permit text placement afterward for narrative slide text.
Do not remove exact ON-IMAGE TEXT requirements.
fail_to_pass: seeded source-art/text-later prompt is blocked with active_textless_prompt
pass_to_pass: safe prompts with exact integrated ON-IMAGE TEXT continue to pass prompt constraints
anti_gaming_notes: Hidden checker should vary the wording: clean reserved paper space, add text afterward, text placement later.
